value.signature: async fn relay (state : Relay) -> Result < () , Refusal >

review.body: { let Relay { shim , socket , startup , key , diagnostics , refusal , } = state ; let result = forward (shim , socket , startup , key , diagnostics , refusal) . await ; if let Err (cause) = & result { tracing :: warn ! (cause = ? cause , outcome = if matches ! (cause , Refusal :: Transport) { "error" } else { "refusal" } , "store relay refused") ; } result }
review.item_premise: The private raw client has no production accessor. Role-only carriers protect configuration, keys and diagnostics; exact frame buffers stay secret-owned until the checked public filter. Public session formatting reveals only the declared case, connection state and disabled persistence. Future-aware spans enter only when polled. Independent relay tasks report bounded terminal causes under their own operation; the connect span ends at handoff rather than measuring the session. The relay publishes its fieldless cause before dropping stream halves; storage copies only the requested public chain and uses the private typed statement vocabulary.
